Name: Prince Argus, The Goldcloak

Voice: young man, adventurer, wide eyes fun little boy, "You're the Young Wolves? You are the best adventurers in the kingdom! Champions and Wizards of all kinds!"

Description: looks exactly like his father but with dark brown hair and much younger. Clearly not very muscular or athletic

Important Info: Son of [[Calix]] and [[Jessica]], Prince of [[Calixos]], nephew of Adrithyr and Annabelle, cousin of [[Lukas]], Susanna, and Kaladin. Young and eager prince, looks up to his cousin a lot and wants to be a good warrior, doesn't care much one way or the other if he becomes King of anywhere.
